title: Omni-UBench: Benchmarking Omni-Modal LLM-based Guardrails Across Safety, Utility, and Reliability
abstract: arXiv:2610.31713v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Advances in Omni-modal Large Language Models (OLLMs) have enabled increasingly seamless human-AI interaction, but their unified processing of heterogeneous modalities also expands the attack surface, allowing adversaries to exploit richer input compositions to circumvent safety alignment. To counter such risks, omni-modal guardrails have been proposed to detect and filter unsafe queries across arbitrary modalities. However, their capabilities and limitations remain insufficiently understood due to the absence of a comprehensive evaluation benchmark. In this paper, we present Omni-UBench, the first comprehensive framework for omni-modal safety assessment, evaluating guardrail models along three critical dimensions, i.e., safety, utility, and reliability. translated_title: Omni-UBench：跨安全性、实用性与可靠性的全模态大语言模型防护栏基准测试
translated_abstract: 全模态大语言模型（OLLMs）的进步使人机交互日益无缝，但其对异构模态的统一处理也扩大了攻击面，使攻击者能够利用更丰富的输入组合来绕过安全对齐。为了应对此类风险，研究者提出了全模态防护栏，用于检测和过滤跨任意模态的不安全查询。然而，由于缺乏全面的评估基准，此类防护栏的能力与局限仍未被充分了解。在本文中，我们提出了Omni-UBench，这是首个全面的全模态安全评估框架，从三个关键维度（即安全性、实用性和可靠性）对防护栏模型进行评估。Omni-UBench汇集了超过18.3万个样本，来自35个以上异构来源，涵盖文本、图像、音频、视频及其跨模态组合，并带有安全标注。（原文摘要此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个全面的全模态安全评估基准Omni-UBench，从安全性、实用性和可靠性三个维度评估基于全模态大语言模型的防护栏模型，涵盖超过18.3万个来自文本、图像、音频、视频及跨模态组合的样本。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Omni-UBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for omni-modal safety assessment, evaluating LLM-based guardrails across safety, utility, and reliability with over 183k samples spanning text, image, audio, video, and their cross-modal combinations.
